categories.label: Landing Page
categories.definition: Public-facing marketing, brand, portfolio, storefront, or showcase websites whose primary job is to present and persuade: a visitor arrives, scrolls a narrative of sections, and converts (buy, sign up, contact, explore).

subcategories.label: Advanced 3D Website Landing Page
subcategories.definition: A marketing or showcase website where real-time 3D (WebGL, Three.js, R3F, shaders, scroll-driven camera moves) is the primary content and structure of the page, not a decorative accent.
subcategories.disambiguation: If the 3D scene were removed and the page would collapse, classify here. If the 3D is a hero accent on an otherwise standard section stack, classify as the underlying landing-page subcategory. Playable games and standalone 3D scenes are outside the v1 taxonomy (future candidate slots).

cross_category_rules.rule: Classify by the primary user intent and core loop of the finished product, not by its visual treatment. A dark, chart-heavy fintech app is Finance; a WebGL-accented SaaS homepage is General Website Landing Page unless the 3D is structural.
Public, scroll-to-convert pages belong to Landing Page. Logged-in work surfaces belong to Enterprise. Logged-in personal-life surfaces belong to Consumer Apps.

When two Enterprise subcategories tie, the primary user's role decides: developer wins Dev Tools, finance operator wins Finance, analyst or executive wins Data and Analytics Dashboard, everyone else wins Productivity Apps.
Every item receives exactly one primary (category, subcategory) pair. Record secondary candidates with confidence scores instead of multi-labeling.

Items that fit no active subcategory (games, standalone 3D scenes, animations, SVG art, utilities) are labeled unclassified with the nearest active candidate and routed to the extension protocol; never force-fit them.

future_candidates_note: Adjacent WDA V6 categories outside the v1 locked slice are tracked only in references/disambiguation-and-extension.md and are NOT active taxonomy entries.

match_statuses.label: Perfect match
match_statuses.description: Score >= 8/10 or reviewer-confirmed direct fit with all core requirements present.

match_statuses.label: Adaptable
match_statuses.description: Score 7/10; usable template when adapted via color, font, or section layout tweaks.

match_statuses.label: No match
match_statuses.description: No template in the review-ready pool satisfies the prompt's page type or domain widgets.

match_statuses.label: Not templatable
match_statuses.description: Requires bespoke interactive canvas/game/simulator logic that should not use a static template.

pair_invalidation_reasons.label: Style Mismatch
pair_invalidation_reasons.description: The template's visual style doesn't fit what the prompt asked for (e.g. dark neon / playful vs. pastel editorial).

pair_invalidation_reasons.label: Missing Features
pair_invalidation_reasons.description: The prompt wants features or components the template doesn't have (e.g. booking calendar, map with listings, configurator) and they'd have to be built from scratch.

pair_invalidation_reasons.label: Specificity
pair_invalidation_reasons.description: The template is too specific to its own domain or content to work for this prompt (bespoke imagery, data, or widgets that do not transfer when re-skinned).

pair_invalidation_reasons.label: Wrong Category
pair_invalidation_reasons.description: The prompt or template is classified in the wrong category or subcategory.

pair_invalidation_reasons.label: Should Be Not-Templatable
pair_invalidation_reasons.description: This prompt requires bespoke interactive logic or canvas work and should not use a static template.

pair_invalidation_reasons.label: Retrieval Missed a Template
pair_invalidation_reasons.description: A better-fitting template exists in the gallery, but retrieval failed to shortlist it.

pair_invalidation_reasons.label: Prompt Unclear
pair_invalidation_reasons.description: The prompt is too vague, underspecified, or ambiguous to match confidently.

adaptation_flags.label: Color
adaptation_flags.description: Palette must change to fit the prompt.

adaptation_flags.label: Font
adaptation_flags.description: Typography must change to fit the prompt.

adaptation_flags.label: Layout
adaptation_flags.description: Sections must be added, removed, or rearranged.

template_loss_tags.label: Slop Inducing
template_loss_tags.description: Likely to pull the generation toward AI-slop patterns (e.g. huge over-used stock photos, bento-box grids, cyberpunk / neon gradients, glassmorphism).

template_loss_tags.label: Spacing
template_loss_tags.description: Awkward spacing the model is unlikely to get right, or that leads to low-quality generations (cramped sections, giant empty gaps, uneven padding).

template_loss_tags.label: Text Density
template_loss_tags.description: Too much text compared with images and media (walls of copy, long link lists, text-only sections).

template_loss_tags.label: Color
template_loss_tags.description: Bad color palette or poor contrast (clashing or muddy colors, unreadable text on color).

template_loss_tags.label: Hero
template_loss_tags.description: Problematic hero section (text over a busy hero image, hero too big or small, awkward placement).

template_loss_tags.label: Content Density
template_loss_tags.description: The design feels busy: too much going on (many competing modules, visual noise, no focal point).

template_loss_tags.label: Layout
template_loss_tags.description: Structural or compositional problems (broken grid, misalignment, confusing section order).
